It is hereby notified that any person/s who have a claim to or inyterest in the intestate property of the late Mr. Samarasingha Arachchige Wickramasingha in the Schedule hereto should submit his/their claim to the undersigned in writing before 03rd March, 2024 stating his/their right or interest to such intestate property.
